_about: ALMAWARE multi-AI fleet registry. The router reads this file to pick the right model per task. Add a model by appending an entry to "models" — no router code change needed.
_routing_note: Hebrew/creative/ALMAWARE/eran route to our OWN model (Eran). Eran v1 is a from-scratch byte-LM PROTOTYPE trained only on Iddo's voice -- each Eran route declares fallback_to [eran-dgx4, sonnet] so when Eran is offline OR returns empty, the request escalates to a real capable model (sonnet = best Hebrew). To send Hebrew NLP straight to sonnet instead, point hebrew/hebrew_nlp back at 'sonnet'.

gemma2:2b.notes: Runs on Cloud Run (deploy_ollama_cloudrun.sh) or local. No API cost. ~2B params, fits free tier.

phi3.notes: Alternate lightweight Ollama model. Slightly stronger reasoning than gemma2:2b.

haiku.notes: Cheapest/fastest Claude. Routine + high-volume work. Strong Hebrew.

sonnet.notes: Complex tasks, code generation, best-in-class Hebrew NLP.

gemini-flash.notes: Google AI Studio free tier. Fast, generous free quota.

gemini-pro.notes: Long context, document analysis, Google integrations. Free tier on AI Studio.

grok.notes: Plain Grok (no live web). Reasoning + training-cutoff knowledge. xAI API.

grok-web.notes: Grok with xAI Live Search ENABLED (real-time web). Use for web-search / current-events tasks. mode=auto lets Grok decide when to search.

eran-local.notes: ALMAWARE's OWN from-scratch byte-LM (eran/chat_server.py on :7800). Loopback is trusted tokenless. PROTOTYPE (4-layer, voice-only corpus) -> fallback_to escalates to DGX Eran then sonnet. Start: python D:/CLAUDE/eran/chat_server.py

eran-dgx4.notes: Eran chat server on DGX-4 (eran4 / edgexpert-3636), reached over an SSH tunnel. Open it first: ssh -N -L 7801:localhost:7800 eran4  (key ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). The tunnel makes the DGX server appear on local :7801; over the tunnel it sees loopback, so no token needed.
